findings.failure_path: DEFAULT_PATHS excludes every repository path except skills and .github. A pull request can preserve an accepted ledger for its reviewed skill changes while adding or modifying Makefile, root scripts, source directories, or other paths. The computed candidate hash is unchanged by those extra bytes, so the workflow gate returns success and the full commit—including unreviewed content—can merge. A change exclusively outside DEFAULT_PATHS is even reported as no reviewed-path change and passes without evidence.
findings.smallest_fix: Diff the whole landing tree before passing. Either include every changed non-evidence path in the frozen candidate, or fail when a changed path lies outside DEFAULT_PATHS and the explicitly excluded committed evidence tree. Add a regression combining a ledger-bound skill change with an out-of-scope file mutation.
